description: MAIA ECAL barrel cell geometry extracted from DD4hep by examples/conversion/extract_ecal_geometry.py. Lengths in mm. Cell (module, layer, x, y) is centered at origin + x*cell_size_x*axis_x + y*cell_size_y*axis_y. half_x, half_y and half_thickness are the half-extents of the silicon box along axis_x, axis_y and normal.
